content.title: Chapter 38 - ENVIRONMENT — Sec. 38-211. - Legislative intent.
content.summary:
It is the intent of the city to require the control of weeds and removal of noxious
               weeds of all kinds from lots and tracts of land within the city in the manner provided
               by C.R.S. § 31-15-401(1)(d).
(Ord. No. 4095, § 4, 11-19-2007)
